title: Na-Dene languages
text: The Na-Dene languages form a proposed language family of indigenous North American languages, comprising the Athabaskan (or Dene) languages, the Eyak language (now extinct), and the Tlingit language, with approximately 40 languages in the Athabaskan branch alone.
